items.title: Pay invoice for hearing aids (co-payment)
items.quote: Den Betrag erbitten wir innerhalb von 30 Tagen nach Rechnungsdatum auf unser Konto;
items.computation: Invoice date (Rechnungsdatum) is 19.11.2026. Period is 'innerhalb von 30 Tagen nach Rechnungsdatum' (period after an event), so per § 187(1) BGB the day of the event (19.11.) is not counted and the period starts on 20.11.2026. Counting 30 days from there gives 19.12.2026 as the 30th day. 19.12.2026 falls on a Saturday. Under § 193 BGB, if the last day of a period that provides for a declaration or performance falls on a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday, the period ends on the next business day. 20.12.2026 is a Sunday, so the next business day is Monday 21.12.2026, which is not a public holiday in NRW. Hence the payment is due by 21.12.2026.
